description: Erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; erection of a rear extension at first floor level, over part of the existing back addition; erection of an adjusted lead lined dormer with French doors and a glazed Juliet balcony to the rear elevation at second floor level; erection of a 1700 mm high obscured glazed screen around part of the remaining flat roof of the existing back addition at second floor level, in connection with the creation of a roof terrace; erection of a 1700 mm high obscured glazed screen around the remaining flat roof of the existing back addition at first floor level, in connection with the creation of a roof terrace; alterations to the existing window to the rear elevation at upper ground floor level; and removal of an existing rooflight to the flat roof at upper ground floor level of the existing lower ground floor back addition.
